note: Scoping fix — INDICATOR_REGISTRY and CANVAS_TO_ID were declared with var inside the compose IIFE which made them invisible to other top-level scripts. The snapshot IIFE could not see INDICATOR_REGISTRY so its Style indicator picker silently skipped the entire render block and the menu only showed the snapshot item. Added window.INDICATOR_REGISTRY = INDICATOR_REGISTRY and window.CANVAS_TO_ID = CANVAS_TO_ID at the bottom of the IIFE. Smoke locks both exports so the scoping bug cannot return. Caught by Opus reading the code instead of guessing.
